system.description: This palm-sized slab ranges from blue-purple at one end to green at the other, with a jagged layer of gold at the purple end. The bearer concentrates. If his player succeeds at a (Manipulation + Socialize) roll at a difficulty of the target's Essence, the hearthstone's bearer has managed to catch his target's eye. The target's player then attempts a Willpower roll at a difficulty of the number of successes the bearer's player received. If the target fails, her bones ignite, inflicting two levels of unsoakable lethal damage every five ticks until death or until the bearer loses sight of her. If the target can escape the bearer's line of sight, the burning stops, and she may heal as normal.
